actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, environment production asset. Create ONE wide 16:9 empty gothic fantasy palace audience hall for the same illustrated world as image 1. Image 1 defines the delicate anime painterly rendering, ornate but believable materials and restrained dramatic light, NOT the room geometry. Image 2 defines the white dragon girl's existing ivory/lavender/silver palette and her refined taste, NOT new character designs; do not draw her or any other person. A long quiet hall with tall pale stone columns and pointed arches, restrained silver filigree, subtle dragon motifs, a single elegant ivory-and-silver high-backed seat on a low three-step dais at the far end, ample clear space for a tiny visitor to stand below. One solitary seat only. The chair has an open-backed/side-clear design to accommodate dragon wings and tail. Tall side windows admit narrow warm dusk light across cool lavender-grey flagstones. A side arch subtly leads to an outdoor elevated terrace suitable for sending a signal, but the main view stays in the hall. Camera near the entrance looking obliquely down the hall toward the distant seat, readable spatial depth, solemn personal solitude rather than a busy royal court. Refined anime illustration, subtle cloth and stone texture, high ceiling and clean silhouettes, painterly light. Not a throne-room crowd, no people, no guards, no extra thrones, no technology, no model version writing, no text of any kind or watermark. One full-bleed environment image, no collage or plan.
